in_arabic.name: Namiq
in_arabic.long_meaning: Namiq هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. From the Arabic root 'numq' which means to be firm or determined. This name is mentioned in the Quran in the story of Prophet Yusuf (as) and his brothers, where they call him 'Namiq' because of his unwavering determination and unyielding spirit.
